steps.note: Open the Single Stage event creation screen.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation as required by the case.
Switch the event type to Auction and configure the available forward-auction settings.
Apply an available auction template so the product sheet is rendered.
Add the specified product as the first line item.
Set the first row's delivery location to the requested plant.
Clear the requested quantity and tab out as the invalid input under test.
Verify the blank quantity is not accepted and is marked or treated as invalid.
Add one available QA vendor so the publish attempt reaches quantity validation.
